items.rationale: Like-for-like fittings for the indoor heating-pipe repair are covered under §§2.4.3(a) and 7.1.7(c). Four at €14 gross each total €56.
Section 7.1.7(c) covers fittings used in the repair; §7.1.8(e) would exclude these if the 28 mm size did not match the repaired connections. Five at €24 gross each total €120.
Section 7.1.7(c) covers this fitting if used in the repaired connections, subject to the dimensional match required by §7.1.8(e). One at €25 gross totals €25.
Minor fasteners used in the repair are covered under §7.1.7(c). Eight at €1.50 gross each total €12.
Pipe supports used to secure the repaired section are covered under §7.1.7(c). Four at €8 gross each total €32.
Like-for-like pipe used to repair the failed indoor heating line is covered under §§2.4.3(a) and 7.1.7(c). The full invoiced 6.4 m at €20 gross per metre totals €128.
Section 7.1.7(g) covers customary trade labour for the insured pipe repair. The full 6.75 billed hours at the gross prior of about €84 per hour give approximately €566.
Section 7.1.7(g) covers customary helper labour for the insured pipe repair. Applying the gross helper-rate prior to all 5.75 billed hours gives €394.
Section 7.1.7(c) covers reinstating the pre-loss insulation on the repaired section. The gross prior for all six pieces is €146.
Wire used to secure the replacement insulation is a covered installation consumable under §7.1.7(c). Two kilograms at €12 gross per kilogram total €24.
Sections 7.1.7(c) and 7.1.8(e) allow lump-sum minor repair consumables, provided they do not duplicate separately billed items under §7.1.8(c). One gross allowance is estimated at €25.
Section 7.1.7(f) allows the first travel charge per contractor per invoice, and this is the only one listed. The gross prior is €80 for one charge.
Sections 5.2.1 and 7.1.7(a) cover disposal of debris from the insured pipe repair, not waste from the unrelated flooring work. The gross prior for one covered disposal charge is €62.
The hallway was not affected, so §§3.5 and 7.1.5 exclude repainting even though it was billed with the covered repair. If eligible, 12 m² at €22 gross per m² would total €264.
The leak did not reach the storage room, and §§7.1.5–7.1.6 do not extend coverage to this separate, undamaged room. If eligible, 15 m² at €65 gross per m² would total €975.
The tap service was unrelated maintenance, excluded under §§7.1.5 and 7.1.8(a). If eligible, the single service would be estimated at €120 gross.
Section 7.1.8(b) expressly excludes processing fees billed on top of itemised labour and materials. The positive conditional estimate for one fee is €25 gross.
